source_text: The World Health Organization classifies FGM into four types—ranging from clitoridectomy to infibulation—and documents empirical health consequences including immediate risks of severe pain, hemorrhage, tetanus, and sepsis, alongside long-term issues such as urinary incontinence, infertility, cysts, and childbirth complications with increased newborn death by 15% and stillbirth by 55%.
